coordinate-grid-limits.controls_text: Additions to the existing coordinate-grid figure for limits work. Only what the grid does not do today: it already graphs pieces with domains, open and closed endpoints, holes, vertical asymptotes, dashed rows and points. Every new control is off by default, so every existing grid drawing (the opening state included) stays as it is. The opening state is an empty grid, so the click handles a teacher would use (switch an endpoint open or closed, click a curve to ask the limit there) cannot be scored and are not entries.
examples: Limit at infinity with a horizontal asymptote
